start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:test-a-finding." Take anything a person noticed or claims (said in a chat or a recording, shared from a page, or an AI's own conclusion), question what it assumes, research the strongest case for it and the strongest case against it in the hardest places it could fail, say how strongly it holds and where it was tested, hand the person one to three small tests to try in their own life, and keep it as a row of their Findings list so only tested findings rise into the summaries they decide from.
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Run workflow:test-a-finding" with the input in the worked example.
2. The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run (row workflow:test-a-finding) and works through its steps in order: capture, question, for, against, verdict, try, keep.
3. Read what each step hands back; the last step is keep.
